1.0.1: Output labels of nested fields now carry the parent name ("From.Username", "Chat.Username") so the variable picker can tell them apart; schemas mark which fields Telegram guarantees (required) and declare the real chat flags.
DeleteMessage explains Telegram's default permission model (own messages only unless the bot is an admin with the Delete messages right) in the tooltip and in the error.
NewMessage tooltip explains the default privacy mode in groups.

Triggers no longer fail to start when two flows of the same bot start at once: the webhook registration is read first and only written when it differs, and a Telegram 429 on setWebhook is retried after the requested delay.
